name: Overwatch Mercy
look: Two stacked panels from a 3D animated cinematic. Top: a frightened dark-haired girl in a white T-shirt and beaded bracelet hides in dark rubble and looks up. Bottom: Mercy, a blonde heroine in a white and orange suit with a halo and spread, glowing golden wings, descends through dusty sunlight holding her staff.
use: The scared girl is someone in trouble and Mercy is the rescuer who swoops in to save them: an unexpected helper, a lucky break or a last-minute fix.

the rescuer who arrives (bottom panel, Mercy)
